chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
None of you should intercept food outside the city, and no resident should sell on behalf of a desert-dweller. Leave the Muslims so that Allah may provide for some of them through others.

key_terms.الْمِصْرِ: the town or settled urban market area
key_terms.طَعَامًا: food goods or provisions being brought for sale
key_terms.لِبَادٍ: for a desert-dweller or outsider coming to sell goods
key_terms.يَتَلَقَّى: to intercept or meet incoming goods before they reach the market

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about intercepting trade goods and selling on behalf of outsiders?
ai.summary: This hadith prohibits intercepting food supplies before they reach the market and forbids a town resident from acting as a selling agent for an outsider in a way that disturbs fair market exchange. It emphasizes leaving trade among Muslims in its natural course so that Allah provides livelihood for some through others.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3988 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (may Allah (swt) bless him and his family) said:
"None of you should intercept food outside the city, and no resident should sell on behalf of a visitor. Leave the Muslims so that Allah (swt) may provide for some of them through others."
